summary: Comprehensive testing of Solana Sniper Bot with new auth, premium, and real Solana RPC features completed. All backend APIs (20/20 tests) passed successfully. Frontend auth flow, premium screen, and all existing features working correctly. Real Solana RPC integration verified with BONK token on-chain data. Multi-wallet endpoints functional with proper authentication and key masking.

critical_code_review_comments: ✅ JWT auth implementation: Proper bcrypt password hashing with $2b$ format
✅ Auth cookies: httpOnly cookies set on login with proper samesite and secure flags
✅ Brute force protection: 5 failed attempts trigger 15-minute lockout
✅ Admin seeding: Idempotent seed_admin updates password if changed
✅ Bearer token auth: Supports both Authorization header and httpOnly cookies
✅ Premium limits: Correct free (1 wallet, 30s scan) vs premium (10 wallets, 5s scan) limits
✅ Real Solana RPC: Helius integration working with on-chain data for BONK token (score=100)
✅ Multi-wallet: Proper authentication required, private keys masked in responses
✅ MongoDB ObjectId: All endpoints correctly exclude _id from responses
✅ Environment variables: JWT_SECRET, STRIPE_API_KEY, HELIUS_RPC_URL properly configured
✅ Frontend auth flow: Login/register toggle, guest mode skip, proper token storage
✅ Premium screen: Conditional rendering based on subscription status (active vs upgrade options)
✅ Tab navigation: Premium tab with Crown icon correctly added to existing tabs
seed_data_creation: Admin user seeded with email: admin@sniperbot.io, password: SniperAdmin123!, role: admin, premium active until 2099-12-31. Test credentials written to /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No wallets added yet (multi-wallet feature ready).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features (JWT auth, premium plans, real Solana RPC, multi-wallet) are fully functional. Backend tests cover auth flows (register, login, logout, /me), premium plans endpoint, real Solana safety audit for BONK token, and multi-wallet CRUD with authentication. Frontend tests verify auth screen with login/register toggle and guest mode, admin login flow, dashboard with user email and PRO badge, Premium tab with Crown icon, and conditional Premium screen content based on subscription status. All existing bot endpoints (state, config, scanner, portfolio, logs) still work after auth changes. Real Solana RPC via Helius is live and returning on-chain data correctly.
